title: Commerce Collections
description: Which collection each kind of store record is kept in. Used as a card in Settings → Commerce.
formgrid:
products discounts
orders transactions
subscriptions carts

id.label: ID
id.help: Reserved — required by the schema system but unused for cards.

products.label: Products
products.help: The collection your products are in. Choose your own collection here when it is on a schema of your own, built on the product parts. Give a collection you made yourself a File Access Group, or its paid downloads are open to anyone.

discounts.label: Discount Codes
discounts.help: The collection discount codes are kept in.

orders.label: Orders
orders.help: The collection orders are kept in. Choose it before the first order: orders already placed stay in the collection they were written to.

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.help: The collection payments and refunds are recorded in.

subscriptions.label: Subscriptions
subscriptions.help: The collection subscriptions are kept in.

carts.label: Carts
carts.help: The collection carts are kept in while buyers shop.
